result.topic_en: End of a chapter noting that the remaining eclipse formulas need exact hourly motions, and the start of a new chapter determining the true place of the lunar node and the true inclination of the lunar orbit from the total lunar eclipse of 28 June 1722.
result.transcription:
De loco lunae ex eclipsibus lunaribus determinando. 377
[?]penitus est contemnendum, propterea quod ex observationibus medium eclipsis momentum [?]curate definire non licet, ut error $5''$ ullius censendus sit momenti. Interim tamen non diffi[?] etiam hunc errorem, postquam veros motus horarios determinaverimus, penitus evitare.
§ 28. Aliter vero est comparata ratio reliquarum formularum, quas in hoc capite elicuimus, [?] valoribus mediocribus litterarum $n, m, k$ sine notabili errore ad usum vocari nequeunt. In [?]licet formulis littera $n$, quae maximis variationibus est obnoxia, non eundem obtinet dimensio[?]merum, tam in numeratore quam in denominatore, quemadmodum in casu tractato evenit, [?] mutabilitatem litterae $n$ numerator et denominator coëfficientis $\frac{n+m+2k}{n-m}$ fere in eadem [?] mutabantur. Hinc sine exacta motuum horariorum cognitione neque temporis momentum, [?]gitudo in orbita aequatur longitudini umbrae in ecliptica, definiri poterit, neque momentum [?]ppositionis luminarium, neque etiam angulus, quem apparens lunae semita cum ecliptica con[?]. Multo minus licebit ex observationibus eclipsium verum locum nodorum et inclinationem [?] lunaris ad eclipticam assignare. Quamobrem in sequenti capite tam veros motus horarios [?] lunae et lineae nodorum investigabimus, quam diametros apparentes et lunae et umbrae [?] quae a parallaxi lunae pendet.

Caput ....
De vero loco nodi atque vera inclinatione orbitae lunaris ad eclipticam.
§ 1. items.quote: Quamobrem in sequenti capite tam veros motus horarios [?] lunae et lineae nodorum investigabimus, quam diametros apparentes et lunae et umbrae [?] quae a parallaxi lunae pendet.
items.english: Therefore in the following chapter we shall investigate both the true hourly motions of [the sun], the moon and the line of nodes, and the apparent diameters of the moon and of the shadow, which depends on the lunar parallax.

items.quote: Multo minus licebit ex observationibus eclipsium verum locum nodorum et inclinationem [?] lunaris ad eclipticam assignare.
items.english: Much less will it be possible to assign from eclipse observations the true place of the nodes and the inclination of the lunar [orbit] to the ecliptic.

items.quote: conveniet verum nodi ascendentis locum cum [?] vera ad eclipticam inclinatione determinari, quoniam hoc commodissime ex observationibus [?]psium totalium effici potest.
items.english: It will be convenient to determine the true place of the ascending node together with the true inclination to the ecliptic, since this can most conveniently be done from observations of total eclipses.
